Oxford Grace Lake Scholarship
The Oxford-Grace Lake Scholarship, funded by Grace Lake Partners in collaboration with the Rewley Fund, is currently open for applications, welcoming entries from qualified Nigerian students in both public and private universities. The scholarship aims to address the educational challenges faced by many young Nigerians who are unable to pursue higher education. This initiative is part of the GLP Cares Foundation, which has generously provided numerous full scholarships to deserving scholars for their studies at reputable private and public universities in Nigeria.
Documents Required
  • Academic transcripts
  • GMAT or GRE scores
  • Any evidence of academic achievements
    • Eligibility Criteria
  • Applicants should be ordinarily resident in Nigeria.
  • Demonstrated academic excellence is essential, and this can be evidenced through degree results, GMAT or GRE scores, university prizes, awards, and other academic achievements.
  • Applicants must exhibit a commitment to Nigeria's development and express a clear intention to contribute to the country's development in the future.
  • Students who are pursuing both bachelor's and master's degree programs are eligible for this scholarship.
